details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:between the end of the fingerprint-cap section (line 703) and `# Deterministic pre-review skip (last gate check):` (line 705) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The sync-PR skip is not wired into the gate, so qualifying sync PRs can follow the normal review and deterministic-skip-merge path.
  WHY: The gate has no call to `review_workflow_sync_skip_applies`, `workflow_sync_managed` skip reason, or `AUTOFIX_GATE_WORKFLOW_SYNC_SKIP` log line, despite the helper being present in the sparse checkout.

- tests/test_review_workflow_sync_skip.py:`_gate_text`, `_sync_block` (lines 70-78) and `test_gate_block_contract` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The contract test searches `review_autofix.yml` for gate-block anchors that are absent because the gate body now lives in `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh`.
  WHY: The test fails with `ValueError: substring not found`; it must inspect the gate script or expanded workflow text.

- tests/test_update_workflows_pr_delivery.py:Fixture.run, lines 284-319 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The commit-step test harness does not supply the signed-path-policy prerequisites and `UPDATE_VIA_PR` default required by the extracted step.
  WHY: The harness exits with `ERR_SYNC_PATH_NOT_ALLOWED reason=allowlist_missing` across 28 cases before exercising delivery behavior. Reviewers disagree on whether this is only a harness omission or also affects production delivery paths; Sonnet reports production verification always precedes this step, while Minimax reports existing delivery modes do not invoke manifest verification.

- tests/test_update_workflows_template_gate.py:test_auto_merge_is_enabled_only_by_the_verify_job (lines 197-208) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The test expects exactly one `gh pr merge` occurrence and none in the commit step, but the new ai-sync delivery path adds two merge calls there.
  WHY: The assertion fails with three occurrences; the test must scope its contract to the `auto/update-workflows-*` flow or the documented contract must be updated.

- tests/test_update_workflows_manifest_verification.py:test_only_summary_runs_unconditionally (lines 70-77) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test scans all workflow steps while asserting that `Summary` is the only step using `always()`.
  WHY: The verify job also has `Mark verify failure` and `Verify summary` using `always()`, so the assertion fails; scope the check to the intended job.

- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml and workflow-templates/ai-update-workflows.yml:git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${SYNC_BRANCH}" and the stale-PR close via -X PATCH ... state=closed; no concurrency: block in either file | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Concurrent updater runs targeting `ai-sync/stable` can close a newer run's PR and force-push an older head without a concurrency lock or verified lease.
  WHY: A delayed run can downgrade consumer workflow pins and leave the PR head inconsistent with verification outputs.

- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:lines 1098-1127 (the new "Signed path policy" precondition inside "Commit and push updates") | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The signed-path policy check aborts the commit step when its allowlist, verifier, or environment prerequisites are missing.
  WHY: The isolated test harnesses fail with `ERR_SYNC_PATH_NOT_ALLOWED reason=allowlist_missing` before delivery logic runs; reviewers disagree on whether verified-manifest outputs are also absent in existing production delivery modes.

- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:steps "Attest sync manifest" ~line 1072 and "Upload sync manifest" ~line 1323; same steps, ~6749-6751 and ~7000-7001 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The sync-manifest attestation and upload steps are gated only on `!inputs.dry_run`, unlike the release-manifest steps that also require release publication and tagging to be enabled.
  WHY: With release publication or tagging disabled, the workflow can attest an unreleased version or attempt to upload an asset to a release that was not created, potentially clobbering an existing asset.

- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:"Send Telegram notification" step, TG level logic near the `Delivery:` message addition | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: An `ai-sync/stable` PR left in `awaiting_merge` remains at `TG_LEVEL=DEBUG` instead of being escalated to `WARNING`.
  WHY: The warning promotion checks only the `auto/update-workflows-*` delivery flow, so a PR requiring human action can be suppressed at the default alert level.

- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:line 1259 (`git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${SYNC_BRANCH}"`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The shared sync branch is force-pushed without `--force-with-lease`.
  WHY: A concurrent writer can have its branch tip clobbered, causing PR creation failures or a `match-head-commit` mismatch during merge.

- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:Alert on sync manifest verification failure, `sync_alert_level="${ALERT_MSG_LEVEL:-SILENT}"` with the `DEBUG|WARNING|ERROR` case | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When `ALERT_MSG_LEVEL` is unset, sync-manifest verification failures produce no Telegram alert.
  WHY: The default alert level is `SILENT`, so rejected attestations or hash mismatches provide no Telegram visibility.

- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:"Summary" step, final lines `Delivery: ${SYNC_PR_STATE}...` followed by `Delivery: ${COMMIT_DELIVERY:-none}` | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: For ai-sync delivery, the summary prints the sync state and then `Delivery: none`.
  WHY: `COMMIT_DELIVERY` is not set by that path, so the summary contradicts itself on every ai-sync run.

- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:"Send Telegram notification" step, `source scripts/tg_helpers.sh || true` | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Suppressing a source failure hides why `tg_send_msg` is unavailable.
  WHY: If sourcing fails, the later command reports `tg_send_msg: command not found` rather than the source failure, making diagnosis less clear.

- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2 in "Attest sync manifest" | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The sync-manifest attestation uses `actions/attest-build-provenance@v2` while the release-manifest attestation uses `@v3`.
  WHY: The attestations in the same job use different major versions of the action; no immediate runtime failure was reported.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Keep sync PRs out of the review merge path. Add and wire a tested review-gate helper that skips review for ai-sync/ PRs only when every changed path is sync-managed, without setting deterministic_skip or otherwise letting review merge them."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The gate script does not call `review_workflow_sync_skip_applies`; the helper is in sparse checkout but is not invoked; the expected gate block and skip log/reason are absent, and the contract test fails with `ValueError: substring not found`.

- requirement: "Give the consumer template `pull-requests: write` and the planned job gate so syncing cannot erase a consumer's hold."
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/ai-update-workflows.yml
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Gemini and Minimax report the job-level `if: ${{ vars.AI_WORKFLOW_AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED != 'false' }}` is missing; Sonnet reports it already exists at line 54 and that the requirement is satisfied.

- requirement: The review-gate helper must cover `ai-sync/` PRs whose changed paths are all sync-managed.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_workflow_sync_skip.sh::review_workflow_sync_skip_applies
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The helper compares against the exact `ai-sync/stable` ref, while the stated requirement and plan specify `ai-sync/` refs; Sonnet reports exact-ref behavior matches the specified design, and tests expect `ai-sync/other` to receive normal review.

- requirement: "Implement the manifest builder and invoke it in both release jobs; grant id-token and attestations write, attest before tag pushes, and upload sync-manifest.json to the release."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, the `Attest sync manifest` and `Upload sync manifest` steps
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The attestation is positioned before the existing tag step and the upload after release creation; the review questions whether upload placement permits consumer download and notes that release switches should gate both steps.

- requirement: Existing contract tests test_only_summary_runs_unconditionally and test_auto_merge_is_enabled_only_by_the_verify_job must pass against the modified workflow.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_update_workflows_manifest_verification.py and tests/test_update_workflows_template_gate.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The workflow-wide scan finds `Mark verify failure` and `Verify summary` as additional `always()` steps; the new ai-sync delivery adds two `gh pr merge` calls in the commit step, and neither tests nor workflow were updated to reconcile the contracts.

- requirement: "The review-gate helper covers `ai-sync/` PRs."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_workflow_sync_skip.sh, `review_workflow_sync_skip_applies`
  confidence=[1]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The helper accepts only `ai-sync/stable`; the reviewer states this matches the specified design and is not a gap.

- requirement: Give the consumer template `pull-requests: write` and the planned job gate.
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/ai-update-workflows.yml
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer reports `pull-requests: write` and `if: ${{ vars.AI_WORKFLOW_AUTO_UPDATE_ENABLED != 'false' }}` already exist at lines 50 and 54; the duplicate kill-switch header text is identified as a documentation nit, not a missing implementation.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
